entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: A human warrior-poet from Ixalan with an affinity for dinosaurs, a planeswalker until the Desparkening, and the romantic partner of Saheeli Rai.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: An artificer and planeswalker who becomes Huatli's partner and, after the Desparkening, finds her way to Ixalan.

entities.name: Angrath
entities.description: A planeswalker who meets Huatli on Ixalan searching for the Immortal Sun and later fights alongside her on Ravnica.

entities.name: Tishana
entities.description: A merfolk who allies with Huatli to keep Kumena from the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Kumena
entities.description: A merfolk rival seeking control of the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: The Immortal Sun
entities.description: A powerful artifact that traps planeswalkers on Ixalan and later on Ravnica, stolen by Tezzeret and used by Bolas, then disabled by Chandra.

entities.name: Orazca
entities.description: The golden city Huatli is tasked to reclaim for the Sun Empire.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: Huatli's home plane.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: The empire of Ixalan Huatli serves as warrior-poet.

entities.name: Apatzec Intli III
entities.description: The emperor of the Sun Empire whom Huatli's poems moved to tears and who honors her.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A planeswalker who steals the Immortal Sun through a planar portal.

entities.name: Zacama
entities.description: The Elder Dinosaur Huatli rides home to demonstrate her success.

entities.name: Vona
entities.description: A vampire fighting for the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Mavren Fein
entities.description: A vampire whose forces later join the defense of Ixalan.

entities.name: Malcolm Lee
entities.description: A siren pirate who draws Huatli's group out of the room.

entities.name: Breeches
entities.description: A goblin pirate who slashes at Vona.

entities.name: Saint Elenda
entities.description: A saint awakened at a tomb in the jungle by Angrath.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane where Huatli is trapped and fights in the War of the Spark.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: Bolas's invasion of Ravnica, in which Huatli fights the Eternals.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The elder dragon who uses the Immortal Sun to trap planeswalkers on Ravnica.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker who leads troops and kills Rhonas; later mourned on Theros.

entities.name: Aurelia
entities.description: Boros angel who leads aerial units with Gideon.

entities.name: Rhonas
entities.description: A God-Eternal leading a battalion of Eternals, killed by Gideon.

entities.name: Ajani
entities.description: A planeswalker who helps protect and rescue civilians.

entities.name: Chandra
entities.description: A planeswalker who disabled the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Pantlaza
entities.description: A young raptor who chose Huatli as a packmate.

entities.name: Inti
entities.description: Huatli's cousin of the same age, killed by Clavileno in the Lost Caverns.

entities.name: Quintorius Kand
entities.description: A planeswalker who accompanies Huatli below Ixalan's surface.

entities.name: Clavileño
entities.description: A vampire-bat transformed by Aclazotz who kills Inti.

entities.name: Vito Quijano de Pasamonte
entities.description: The leader of the Queen's Bay Company vampires, killed by Huatli with his own lance.

entities.name: Aclazotz
entities.description: A bat god who transformed vampires of the Queen's Bay Company into demonic vampire-bats.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian invasion of Ixalan, which Huatli defends against.

entities.name: Desparkening
entities.description: The event in which Huatli and Saheeli lost their planeswalker sparks.

events.summary: Huatli rises to a station just short of nobility through her skill at sword, magic and controlling dinosaurs.
events.quote: Huatli rose to a station just short of nobility

events.summary: Huatli fights vampire incursions on the Sun Coast and is honored by the Emperor.
events.quote: Huatli fought against the vampire incursions on the Sun Coast

events.summary: Angrath tells Huatli he seeks the Immortal Sun and in their battle her spark ignites.
events.quote: In their battle, her spark ignited

events.summary: Huatli is proclaimed warrior-poet and tasked to reclaim the Golden City.
events.quote: Huatli was proclaimed warrior-poet of the Empire and tasked by the Emperor to reclaim the Golden City for the Sun Empire.

events.summary: Huatli teams with Tishana to keep Kumena from the Immortal Sun.
events.quote: Huatli temporarily joined up with the merfolk Tishana

events.summary: After Angrath leaves her, Huatli sends a dinosaur to trample him in the mud.
events.quote: Huatli reacted by sending a Dinosaur to trample him in the mud.

events.summary: Everyone scrambles to touch the Immortal Sun and a current of energy rushes through them.
events.quote: everyone scrambled to touch the Immortal Sun.

events.summary: Tezzeret steals the Immortal Sun through a planar portal.
events.quote: Tezzeret stole the Immortal Sun through a planar portal

events.summary: Now able to planeswalk, Huatli returns home riding Zacama, and the emperor lets her use the title Warrior-Poet.
events.quote: Huatli first returned home, using the Elder Dinosaur Zacama as a mount

events.summary: Huatli planeswalks away from Ixalan.
events.quote: she planeswalked away.

events.summary: Huatli arrives in Ghirapur and is greeted by Saheeli.
events.quote: When she arrived in Ghirapur

events.summary: Huatli begins a relationship with Saheeli.
events.quote: Huatli began a relationship with Saheeli.

events.summary: Huatli and Saheeli are lured to Ravnica and trapped there by Bolas's use of the Immortal Sun.
events.quote: Huatli and Saheeli were lured back to Ravnica by the Interplanar Beacon and immediately became trapped there

events.summary: Huatli mocks Angrath for getting trapped by the Immortal Sun again.
events.quote: Huatli encountered Angrath at the meeting and mocked him for getting trapped by the Immortal Sun again.

events.summary: Huatli, Gideon, Aurelia and Angrath lead a force against God-Eternal Rhonas.
events.quote: led a massive force of planeswalkers and Boros, Izzet, and Simic troops into battle against the God-Eternal Rhonas

events.summary: Gideon kills Rhonas and Huatli joins Ajani's civilian evacuation.
events.quote: After Gideon killed Rhonas

events.summary: Huatli remains on Ravnica after Chandra disables the Immortal Sun and later sings a poem for Gideon on Theros.
events.quote: There, she sang a poem for him.

events.summary: The raptor Pantlaza chooses Huatli as a packmate.
events.quote: the young raptor Pantlaza chose Huatli as a packmate.

events.summary: Huatli leads the defense of Ixalan in the New Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: Huatli led the defense of the plane.

events.summary: Huatli and Saheeli lose their sparks in the Desparkening.
events.quote: Huatli and Saheeli lost their sparks in the Desparkening

events.summary: Huatli leads a party below the plane's surface through Orazca.
events.quote: Huatli traveled below the plane's surface.

events.summary: Clavileño kills Inti.
events.quote: Inti was killed by Clavileño

events.summary: Huatli summons dinosaurs and kills the vampire leader Vito.
events.quote: Huatli summoned dinosaurs and killed the vampire leader
